items.title: Chippewa County Proposes 10-Month Data Center Pause Over Water and Power Use
items.dek: The Planning and Zoning Committee seeks a moratorium from September 2026 to July 2027 that would cover six towns after residents raised concerns about energy consumption, water demand, noise, and property values.
items.judge_note: Concrete new development: a specific committee in Chippewa County is seeking a moratorium with defined dates and scope across six towns.
